source: Coordinates from English Wikipedia, retrieved 19 November 2026 via the MediaWiki API (prop=coordinates).

area.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
area.note: The Walk runs along Hollywood Boulevard and Vine Street. Pin coordinates are the Wikipedia locations of the named landmarks; star-segment pins sit at those landmarks along the sidewalks.

pins.name: TCL Chinese Theatre
pins.blurb: Historic movie palace at 6925 Hollywood Blvd. Pins here are on the public sidewalk in front of the theatre, not inside.
pins.label: TCL Chinese Theatre

pins.name: Dolby Theatre
pins.blurb: Home of the Academy Awards, at Hollywood Blvd and Highland Ave. Sidewalk pin only.
pins.label: Dolby Theatre

pins.name: Star segment: Hollywood Blvd at the Roosevelt
pins.blurb: Wikipedia notes the blocks outside the Chinese Theatre and the Roosevelt as prime Walk of Fame star locations.
pins.label: Roosevelt

pins.name: Star segment: Hollywood Blvd at El Capitan
pins.blurb: Sidewalk stars along Hollywood Blvd at El Capitan Theatre, across from the Chinese / Highland cluster.
pins.label: El Capitan

pins.name: Star segment: Hollywood Blvd at the Egyptian
pins.blurb: Mid-boulevard star segment near Grauman's Egyptian Theatre.
pins.label: Egyptian

pins.name: Star segment: Hollywood Blvd and Vine
pins.blurb: The Hollywood Blvd and Vine Street crossing, a well-known stretch of the Walk of Fame.
pins.label: Hollywood & Vine

pins.name: Star segment: Vine Street at Capitol Records
pins.blurb: Walk of Fame stars also run along Vine Street. This pin is at the Capitol Records Building.
pins.label: Capitol Records

pins.name: Walk of Fame corner — flat video demo
pins.blurb: One small corner of the Walk of Fame on Hollywood Blvd, west of the Chinese Theatre. Flat video shown on a curved screen — a demo of turning flat footage into a 360-style view.
pins.label: Flat video demo

pins.name: Example business pin — your business here
pins.blurb: EXAMPLE — not a real business and not a paid listing. This is what a buyer's pin looks like: a 60-second clip of their location on the globe for 1 year, with their name and a link (the demo clip here is a 30-second excerpt). Tap it to see the clip, and the sales page for prices and the free 45-second preview.
pins.label: Example pin

pins.name: Kyoto room
pins.sourceName: Test asset, not the real place — SharedTestModels (raymondyfei), kyoto_room, CC0 1.0
pins.blurb: Test asset, not the real place. A Gaussian splat of a Kyoto room (CC0) opened in a 3D viewer — not a walk of a Hollywood street and not a capture of this pin's surroundings.
pins.label: Kyoto room

pins.name: Street intersection
pins.sourceName: Test asset, not the real place — cfahlgren1 street splat, CC BY 4.0 (not an official Tesla asset)
pins.blurb: Test asset, not the real place and not an official Tesla asset. A 3D Gaussian splat of a suburban street intersection (cfahlgren1, from Tesla FSD dashcam footage, CC BY 4.0). A soft-glow walker marks 'you' among realistic CC0 people and cars on the sidewalks and in the lanes. Converted and downsampled for this preview.
pins.label: Street intersection

pins.name: Ludlow courtyard
pins.sourceName: Quality Square, Ludlow, UK — ijenko courtyard splat, CC BY 4.0
pins.blurb: A 3D Gaussian splat of Quality Square in Ludlow, Shropshire, UK (ijenko, XGRIDS LixelKity K1, CC BY 4.0). A soft-glow walker marks 'you' among realistic CC0 people on the cobbles. The parked car is part of the scan. Cropped and converted for this preview; see media/splat/LUDLOW-ATTRIBUTION.md.
pins.label: Ludlow courtyard

pins.name: The Grove
pins.blurb: A video walk through The Grove, Los Angeles, from private test footage. Hold Move up to walk. Flat video, not 360. Audio is off because bystanders can be heard.
pins.label: The Grove

pins.name: Farmers Market
pins.blurb: A video walk through the Original Farmers Market, Los Angeles, from private test footage (the whole 52-second clip). Hold Move up to walk. Flat video, not 360. Audio is off because bystanders can be heard.
pins.label: Farmers Market
